title: Verify sustained operation and publish the completion report
objective: The program closes only after the product stays useful and honest under actual refresh.
outcome: Fourteen actual elapsed observation days and two complete scheduled cycles remain unrun. Missing observation time remains unverified. Creating a scheduled automation is not evidence that it ran. Generated dates do not count. After-refresh recheck retains failed and unverified R01-R16 results; an old passing receipt cannot cover changed data. Completion is not declared. Astra cannot grant owner scientific/release authority. C-009-1 remains unresolved. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Production is unchanged.

commits.subject: Collect the sustained-operation evidence
commits.instructions: Observe at least fourteen days and two full scheduled cycles with source attempts, freshness, queue age, cost, review backlog and public health. Notify only meaningful changes.
commits.verification: Missing observation time or a failed cycle remains unverified; a scheduled automation being created is not evidence that it ran.

commits.subject: Recheck the acceptance vector after refresh
commits.instructions: Verify cohort readiness, source/schema changes, examples, machine parity and no silent data loss after real publication updates. Confirm actual budget and retention behavior.
commits.verification: A regression reopens the affected requirement and creates a bounded remediation task; an old passing receipt cannot cover changed data.

commits.subject: Publish completion and continuing ownership
commits.instructions: Astra signs the independent technical review; record owner release/scientific decisions and named ongoing responsibilities. Publish coverage limits and the current evidence report.
commits.verification: Declare completion only when every requirement has a current passing witness or an explicitly amended, reasoned acceptance decision; no hidden waived deficits.
